name: Vilnius
tagline: Baroque old town and a cheeky artists' republic
summary: Vilnius has one of Europe's largest baroque old towns, a UNESCO maze of church spires and courtyards. Climb Gediminas Tower for the view, visit the self-declared Republic of Užupis, see the Gate of Dawn, and day-trip to Trakai's red-brick island castle.
seasonNote: Late spring to early autumn is warm and lively; winter is cold with Christmas markets.
arrival: Vilnius Airport is 15 minutes from the old town by train or bus.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; buses and Bolt.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere.
foodTip: Cepelinai (potato dumplings) and cold pink beet soup.
